name: Can I make changes to my finish selections during the project?

mainEntity.name: Can I make changes to my finish selections during the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's best to finalize finish selections before work begins to maintain project timelines and budgets, minor changes can sometimes be accommodated. However, making significant changes after materials have been ordered or installation has started can lead to delays and additional costs. This is a practical tradeoff: flexibility for late changes often comes at the expense of increased project duration or budget, as it may involve restocking fees, new material orders, and labor adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor finish changes may be possible, but significant alterations after ordering or installation can cause delays and extra costs.
